delivery.label: 有效产物已提交
delivery.meaning: 仅表示优化智能体已提交并通过必需文件检查，不代表任何光学指标达标。

agent_verdict.reason: Seed_198 (L_002 Double Gauss, internal stop, all-spherical) optimized to a physically feasible design with all three exact first-order targets within 0.5%: EFL 49.94 mm (-0.11%), FOV 47.05 deg (+0.10%), F/# 1.990 (-0.50%), packaging preserved (BFL 17.73 mm vs 18 starting, TTL 75.71 mm vs 75, no surface overlap, min spacing 2.95 mm). Image quality is moderate: polychromatic RMS spot 34.8/47.7/98.9 um center/mid/edge, distortion <=2.6%, geometric MTF50 ~5.9 cy/mm on axis and edge tangential/sagittal 12.2/6.0 cy/mm (persistent ~2x edge astigmatism); effective-ray fraction was not reported so edge conclusions are coverage-limited. The contract states exact targets with no tolerances, so acceptance is unknown_tolerance and a pass cannot be claimed; no explicit constraint is measurably violated.
agent_verdict.stop_reason: Refinement of the chosen seed_198 lineage plateaued: the third round changed total loss by only ~1.6% and traded EFL/FOV fidelity for a marginal center-spot gain while the ~2x edge tangential/sagittal MTF anisotropy was unchanged across all rounds, indicating a topology/freedom residual rather than an iteration shortfall. With no user acceptance tolerances, further refinement or an asphere probe cannot change the pass/uncertain verdict, so optimization stops at the most contract-faithful candidate (candidate-002).

note: Raw tool output is stored in agents/, events/, engines/, and verification/; it is referenced rather than embedded here.
